title: Review on progress of rare earth molecule-based functional materials in 2025
claim: Anionic templates and recognition interfaces can steer hierarchical or confined assembly of rare-earth clusters and track coordination in real time through luminescence.
explanation: Anionic templates carrying geometric information convert [CeNi] units from octahedral to lantern-like and then to hybrid octahedral–dodecahedral clusters. Pyridine and hydroxyl arrays lining cyclic rare-earth aluminium channels capture and transform iodine. Anion transporters that hydrogen-bond to BDC carboxylate oxygens give spatiotemporally selective assembly, while luminescence intensity reports the coordination process.
scope: Template- and microenvironment-directed assembly of heterometallic rare-earth clusters and carboxylate frameworks.
conditions: Anion templates; channel-wall pyridine/hydroxyl arrays; hydrogen-bonding anion transporters with BDC.
caveats: Cluster topology and iodine uptake are case-specific; the review does not give a general template-to-topology map.
